subject: [PATCH 3/6] daxctl: offline whole-device memory via atomic unplug when available

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch adds the ability to offline whole-device memory via atomic unplug when available, ensuring that no agent can online blocks before a later unbind. The kernel offlines and removes the device atomically, leaving it unchanged on failure. If all memory sections are already offline, the operation is a best effort. The patch also updates the 'daxctl list' command to omit 'movable' for devices with no blocks.
